annotations.title: Get recorded conditions of a plan or product

description: Use this when: you need every recorded condition, pricing rule and source sentence of one plan or product found by search or named by the user. Do not use this when: you want to compare plans against a workload (use search or check_conditions). Get every recorded condition for one API plan or product: value, which plans it applies to, exceptions, official source sentence, check date and purchase link. A product too long for one response comes with one source sentence per fact. recent_changes lists the facts of the plan or product that changed in the last 30 days, with the previous and the new value and sentence and the date, and the facts whose sentence the daily re-check could not find again; it is left out when there are none. Example: every recorded condition of 1 plan found by search.

inputSchema.description: Give exactly one of offer_id or product_id.

name: get_details

evidence_detail.description: Present when the product was too long for one response: each fact carries one source sentence. Ask for a plan by offer_id for every sentence.

link_notes.description: The note of each link level (link.link_level) of the plans in this result, stated once.

also_stated_in.description: get_details only: other official machine-readable documents of the provider (llms.txt, llms-full.txt, OpenAPI files, MCP tool listings) that contain the same quoted sentences.

applies_to.description: get_details only: billing options (billing) or search engines (search_engines) the fact is limited to.

at_limit.description: Present for a plan with no automatic extra usage: what the official page says happens at the limit (kind no_extra_usage or restart_by_hand), with its sentence. With a workload that needs restarts, restarts gives their count, the price of each and the total, the numbers of monthly_cost.explanation.

concurrency_unit.description: get_details, concurrency only: the unit the page states the value in (unit, text such as "100 threads"). Against concurrent requests: equals_requests (value, text and the official line of the unit rule) when the unit rule counts this unit as requests, else note "not the same unit as concurrent requests"; "unit not stated" when the page names none.

derived.description: How the value follows from the quoted sentence when it is not literal.

quote.description: The sentence as it appears on that page.

retrieved_at.description: Date the page was read (YYYY-MM-DD). Only with detail=full.

source.description: Official page the sentence was found on.

exceptions.description: get_details only: plans with a different value.

level.description: Where the fact is recorded: offer (the plan), product or provider.

status.description: TRUE: stated with the value; FALSE / NOT_SUPPORTED: stated as unavailable; UNKNOWN: not stated; CONFLICT: official pages disagree (value lists each version); STALE: past its recheck date; MISSING: not recorded.

via_exception.description: Present and true when a plan-specific exception replaced the general value.

provider_url.description: The provider page itself. Only in a page made for a browser, where url is this service's address that forwards to it; MCP and REST results do not carry it.

url.description: The only address to visit the plan: this service's /go/<offer_id>?r=<token> address, which forwards to the provider page. The token is made for this response and holds nothing about you.

plan_page.description: The link to give the user with this plan, as a markdown link named "<provider> <plan> — plan page" (its pricing and sign-up page). The evidence sources under the conditions are for citing a condition.

also_stated_in.description: get_details only: other official machine-readable documents of the provider (llms.txt, llms-full.txt, OpenAPI files, MCP tool listings) that contain the same quoted sentences.

level.description: Where the fact is recorded: offer (the plan), product or provider.

status.description: TRUE: stated with the value; FALSE / NOT_SUPPORTED: stated as unavailable; UNKNOWN: not stated; CONFLICT: official pages disagree (value lists each version); STALE: past its recheck date; MISSING: not recorded.

via_exception.description: Present and true when a plan-specific exception replaced the general value.

agent_access.description: The provider's machine channels as last checked: its official MCP server (whether it answered without credentials, how it asks for them, tool names), llms.txt and OpenAPI files. Only listing requests were made. null when not checked.

data_use_scope.description: Pages read, robots.txt results, the terms-of-use record and rights: the provider's rights state and whether this service serves it, and the rights of each source page.

recent_changes.description: Present only when a fact of this plan or product (or of its provider) changed in the last 30 days or its source sentence could not be found again, newest first, at most 20.

after.description: One version of the fact: its value, its source sentence(s), the date it was checked and its status. null when the fact did not exist (before) or the sentence could not be found again (after).

before.description: One version of the fact: its value, its source sentence(s), the date it was checked and its status. null when the fact did not exist (before) or the sentence could not be found again (after).

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the day the record changed, or the day the re-check could not find the sentence.

key.description: The fact key, for example price_monthly.

kind.description: changed: the recorded value or sentence differs from the one before; added: a cell that had no recorded fact before is filled (before is null); not_found_again: the daily re-check could not find the recorded sentence on the official page.

offer_id.description: The plan, when the fact is recorded for one plan; null for a product or provider fact (it applies to the plans below it).

title: Get recorded conditions of a plan or product
